title: Ride-Sharing Peak Pricing
scenario: Calculate the 3-hour rolling average fare for a specific city to determine peak pricing triggers.
tableSchema: rides (ride_id INT, city_id INT, fare NUMERIC, request_time TIMESTAMP)
hint: Use RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '3 hours' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW.
correctQuery: SELECT city_id, request_time, AVG(fare) OVER(PARTITION BY city_id ORDER BY request_time RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '3 hours' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_fare FROM rides;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE rides (ride_id INT, city_id INT, fare NUMERIC, request_time TIMESTAMP);
